summary: In Python docs each section is a variable like DOCUMENTATION = r''' ... ''', while in YAML it's a mapping key DOCUMENTATION:, so converting just means moving the YAML out of the variables; a full side-by-side example is given.
questions: How do I convert my Python DOCUMENTATION string to a YAML doc file?
What's the difference between Python and YAML plugin documentation formats?

answer_card.title: Python vs YAML documentation format
answer_card.answer_md:
Python:
```python
DOCUMENTATION = r'''
  description: something
  options: ...
'''
EXAMPLES = r''' ... '''
```
YAML:
```yaml
DOCUMENTATION:
  description: something
  options: ...
EXAMPLES: ...
```
The Python variables already hold YAML; just move it out into top-level keys.
